curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach how violations earn points, the speeding bands and other point examples, the two-year active window, then the Driver Safety Program credit, required courses and the ninety-day deadline.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Point-value cards by violation; contrast cards for the speeding bands and for adult versus under-twenty-one course triggers.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on point values, the active window and safety course rules.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the insurance requirement and the minimum limits, what triggers a request for proof, how the Certificate of Compliance works and its deadline, and court convictions for driving uninsured.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for the minimum limits, triggers and deadline; contrast card for the BMV request versus a court conviction.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on insurance minimums and proving coverage.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach what an SR22 does, how indefinite no-insurance suspensions are stayed and ended, what an SR26 does, the reinstatement fee tiers and the SR22 alternative, then court-related suspensions and driving while suspended.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each SR22 and fee rule; contrast cards for the fee eras and the stay versus termination.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on how a described suspended driver gets back on the road.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Cover the legal BAC limit and its factors, chemical test penalties, interlock devices and teen citations, watercraft offenses, child support and bad-payment suspensions, then checking your record and reinstatement.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Penalty cards for chemical tests and other suspensions; contrast cards for fail versus refuse and viewable versus official records.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on suspension lengths and how to check and clear a record.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach the three habitual violator tiers and their suspensions, the worked example, then Restriction five and the conditions for specialized driving privileges.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Tier cards with their suspension lengths; contrast cards for two, three and ten offenses.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Hub-chosen quiz on which tier a described record falls into.
